segments.caption: A wide, hazy view of an airport runway at dawn or dusk, framed by trees in the foreground and distant city buildings on the horizon. An airplane, appearing as a small red silhouette, enters the frame from the top and descends steadily toward the runway, marking the main event of the scene.

Below, a long airport runway stretches toward the horizon, flanked by green fields and a distant treeline with city buildings visible in the background. The scene is viewed from a distance, framed by trees in the foreground, creating a serene and expansive view of an airport in the golden hour.

An airplane, its landing lights glowing, descends steadily toward a runway bathed in the warm, hazy light of either sunrise or sunset. The scene is framed by a foreground of lush green trees and a distant city skyline, with the long, dark runway stretching toward the horizon as the aircraft approaches for landing.
